name: Harbor Compliance
summary: US business compliance service and software: registered agent addresses in every state, LLC formation and incorporation, annual report filing, foreign qualification, licensing and an Entity Manager that tracks each entity's status and deadlines, for companies registered in several states and the firms that manage them.
best_for: companies registered in several US states, and the accountants or law firms who manage entities for them, that want registered agent addresses, annual report deadlines and state filings tracked in one place, with a software view of every entity's status
skip_if: you have one LLC in one state and file your own annual report, since the state fee is the only unavoidable cost of that and Harbor's $199 a year per state is for having it done; or you want the lowest possible formation price, since Harbor's formation starts at $99 where some competitors advertise $0
honest_knock:
The $99 on every page is a first-year price. Registered agent renews at $159 a year, about 60% more, and the only way to keep $99 is to prepay two or three years. The same page sets its own price against an unnamed 'competition' at $250 to $350 'with large annual increases', which is a comparison you cannot check, and its own renewal is an increase too. Budget on $159.

The recurring filing is where the bill grows. Annual report service is $199 per state per year, plus the state's own fee, which Harbor invoices before the due date. For a company registered in three states that is $597 a year in service fees before any state charges, on top of a registered agent in each of those states. Volume discounts of up to 40% exist, but only online and without a published table.

The formation price is a starting point rather than a package. LLC formation and incorporation both read 'starting at $99 plus state fees', and the public pages do not list what the $99 covers or what the higher options add; the answer is in the order flow. The software that the agent service leans on, Entity Manager, is included with the agent, but the wider software suite has no published price and starts with a demo.

The ratings on the pages are Google reviews that Harbor Compliance quotes itself. We found no independent reviews we could read for this dossier, and we have not used the service.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-04 on harborcompliance.com, service page by service page; there is no single pricing page, /pricing returns a 404) Priced per service, each with its own page. Registered agent is $99 for the first year for new customers and renews at $159 a year; paying two years up front is $198 and three years $297, both at the $99 rate, after which it renews at $159. The agent price includes same-day electronic document delivery, a phone call when legal papers are served, unlimited document storage, pre-filled state forms and the Entity Manager software, with no per-delivery fees. Formation: LLC formation and incorporation both start at $99 plus state fees. Annual report filing is $199 per state per year plus the state's filing fee, with volume discounts of up to 40% when ordered online. Foreign qualification is a $399 service fee that includes a name check, the good-standing certificate or certified copies, the filing and one year of registered agent service. Other one-off filings: EIN from $99, certificate of good standing $175 plus state fees, corporate amendment from $299 plus state fees per state, reinstatement from $399 plus state fees, certificate of withdrawal from $499 plus state fees, and business licensing from $500 plus state fees. A virtual business address is $350 a year. Nonprofit formation is sold through its partner Foundation Group at $1,499, $2,499 or $3,499 plus filing fees. The compliance software (Entity Manager, License Manager, Records Manager, Tax Manager) has no published price; the software pages offer a demo and a free trial account. Harbor Compliance LLC; the copyright line runs from 2012.

compare_with.name: ZenBusiness
compare_with.why: ZenBusiness is the formation service in our own dossiers that sells the same lines a la carte, so the comparison is line by line. Read on 22 September 2026, ZenBusiness charges $0 for formation plus state fees, $199 a year for a registered agent and $100 per annual report filed. Harbor Compliance, read on 4 October 2026, charges from $99 for formation, $99 for the first year of registered agent and $159 a year after that, and $199 per state per year for annual report filing. A single-state LLC therefore pays less with ZenBusiness in year one for formation and less with Harbor for the agent from year one onward ($159 against $199), while annual reports cost twice as much at Harbor. ZenBusiness is built around first-time founders and adds websites, email and banking; Harbor is built around companies in several states and the firms that manage them, with entity-tracking software, foreign qualification and licensing.
